mutants.name: factorial_no_dupes
mutants.desc: product over nodes of (#children)! -- forgets that isomorphic siblings give identical orderings

mutants.name: raw_substring_key
mutants.desc: multinomial of child orderings at every node, but siblings compared by their raw substring (ordered), not by unordered tree shape

mutants.name: size_key
mutants.desc: multinomial of child orderings at every node, but siblings considered identical when their subtrees have the same size

mutants.name: top_level_only
mutants.desc: only permutes the top-level blocks (distinct orderings of root children), ignores nested reorderings
